headline: 1MDB: RM31.3B Recovered, RM20.1B Left To Pay, RM6B Still In Arbitration
context: In May 2026 MACC put 1MDB recoveries at RM31.3B as of 2025, 74.5% of the RM42B it says was misappropriated. In October 2026 MOF said the government still faces RM20.1B in 1MDB obligations if nothing more is recovered. Goldman contests a USD1.4B guarantee in London arbitration.

changes.summary: Correction: Earlier editions said MACC's RM42 billion baseline was 1MDB's 2015 debt, said the RM31.3 billion recovery figure counts Goldman's disputed US$1.4 billion guarantee, and put in quotation marks a phrase no one had said; MACC calls the RM42 billion funds misappropriated, no published breakdown shows the guarantee counted, the closing card now quotes no one, and the RM31.2 billion, RM5.29 billion and RM24.46 billion figures now cite the Finance Ministry's November 2025 reply, which covers 1MDB and SRC.

Update: In October 2026 the Finance Ministry told Parliament the government had paid RM42.5 billion on 1MDB by 31 August 2026 and would still have to bear RM20.1 billion if nothing more is recovered; the headline, summary, opening card and closing card now use that figure.

cards.big: MACC says RM31.3B was recovered from 1MDB. In October 2026 the Finance Ministry said RM20.1B in 1MDB obligations remains.
cards.sub: Of Goldman's USD3.9B 2020 settlement, USD2.5B was cash. The remaining USD1.4B (about RM6B) is an asset-recovery guarantee Goldman filed at the LCIA in October 2023 to contest.

cards.big: Of Goldman's USD3.9B 2020 settlement, only USD2.5B was paid in cash
cards.sub: Goldman filed at the LCIA on 11 October 2023, arguing Malaysia had already recovered enough to satisfy the USD1.4B guarantee. MOF told Parliament in October 2025 the dispute is still in arbitration.

cards.big: MOF told Parliament RM31.2B was recovered for 1MDB and SRC from December 2018 to September 2025. RM5.29B of it remained.
cards.sub: Recovered funds go only to 1MDB and SRC debts and commitments, MOF said. 1MDB's debt obligations stood at RM24.46B, RM15.44B of it advances from MOF and MOF Inc.

cards.big: MACC measures its '74.5% recovered' against the RM42B it says was misappropriated from 1MDB. The US DOJ's figure: more than US$4.5B.
cards.sub: Pick the baseline and you pick the percentage. MACC's RM31.3B also counts asset sales and settlements with Goldman, IPIC/Aabar, Deloitte and KPMG.

cards.big: The question is not how much was recovered. It is which number the next press release counts.
Think of a household that wins back stolen savings and sends most of them straight to old loans
cards.sub: The recovery is real. Of RM31.2B recovered for 1MDB and SRC by September 2025, RM5.29B was left, and 1MDB's debt obligations stood at RM24.46B.

cards.big: RM31.3B recovered is real. Reading 74.5% as a scandal nearly settled outruns what the ledger shows.
cards.sub: It measures against MACC's RM42B, not the DOJ's US$4.5B. Most recovered money has gone to old debts. And in October 2026 MOF said RM20.1B remains to be paid if nothing more is recovered.
